messages:
Nina: FYI planning a small migration lane for models with ABI changes that break adapters. Need a policy for model pin windows and customer notification cadence.
Owen: propose default pin gracepath 21 days for ABI bumps, with auto-notice at days 0,7,14, and a final deprecation at 21. customers can request extension if they provide migration plan.
Priya: need technical checklist: adapter compatibility test, shim availability, sample adapter code, and breaking-change manifest. Also require a fallback runtime that can serve old adapters for 30 days.
LegalBot: reminder: if third-party adapters depend on vendor code, include vendor license in manifest and flag any redistribution restrictions.
SRE-Bot: rollback policy: if >2 tenants report failures within 24h, immediate hold and partial rollback. add monitoring hook to detect adapter load errors.
Nina: ok i'll draft the policy and include the notification templates. aim to publish as a policy doc next week.
Owen: i'll implement auto-notice emails and pin controls in console.
Priya: i'll create example shim and adapter test harness.
Nina: thanks all. will open PR with policy text and link to CAT-4999.
